[LGRA.2.8.11] **A `NAME` in a `time_expr`** names a constant ([LGRA.4.1])
whose value is a `Duration`. The compiler must read the constant's folded
value at that position as it reads a `UNIT_LIT` of the same duration, so a
rule the position sets on its duration ([LTIM.2.7.1], [LGRA.13.5],
[LGRA.5.2]) holds of the value. The compiler must refuse any other `NAME` in
a `time_expr`: one that names a constant whose value is a quantity of
another dimension with `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_UNIT_DIMENSION`, as it refuses a
`UNIT_LIT` of another dimension ([LLEX.12.8]); one that names a constant of
any other type with `DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH`; and one that names no
constant, a binding included, with `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_CONST`.
